On 2026-11-23 the wind fleet generated a mean of 6988 MW, ranging from a minimum of 4031 MW to a maximum of 11507 MW. Compared with the previous seven‑day average of 7963 MW, wind output was 12.2% lower. The day‑ahead wind forecast showed a mean absolute error of 1208 MW, well below the baseline error of 6008 MW.

System demand averaged 35034 MW with a peak of 43134 MW, higher than the prior week’s mean of 32701 MW by 7.1%. The demand forecast achieved a mean absolute error of 1072 MW versus a baseline of 1603 MW and a mean absolute percentage error of 2.94%.

Electricity price averaged £195.9/MWh, between a low of £154.6/MWh and a high of £251.2/MWh. The weekly mean of £186.1/MWh rose by 5.2% on the previous period.

Data quality checks covered 29 series, with 25 passing, 2 warning and 2 failing. Issues were recorded for wind_onshore (FAIL), wind_offshore (FAIL), price_apx (WARN) and price_n2ex (WARN).
